_comment: Post-event article refresh (agents/event-refresh-agent, framework/core/seasonal_calendar.recently_ended). The day after a seasonal_calendar occasion of one of `kinds` ends, every published article tagged holiday:<occasion-id> on each site below gets one Opus article-refresh rec (past-tense event copy, re-angle to seasonal_calendar.next_occasion, event dropped from the title, slug kept). A storage copy at config/event-refresh-config.json replaces this repo file wholesale. `default` merges under every site; with `sites` empty the agent treats every DATABASE_URL_<SITE> env var as a site. Only VALUES live here; the selection and rec logic stay in the agent.
